Events from the year 2026 in the United Kingdom.
Events
Predicted and scheduled events
* 6 April – A new law comes into force in England banning the keeping of all Primate species as pets in domestic settings.
* 7 May – 2026 United Kingdom local elections
* June to July – England will host the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup
* 23 July to 2 August – The 2026 Commonwealth Games will be held in Glasgow.
* 10 to 16 August – The 2026 European Athletics Championships will be held at the Alexander Stadium in Birmingham.
* Summer – Wales will host the 2026 UEFA European Under-19 Championship
